quarantine.mr_name: SAM optional tag field permutation preserves semantics
quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) after canonical normalization (sorted optional tags)

evidence.quote: Each alignment line has 11 mandatory fields (QNAME, FLAG, RNAME, POS, MAPQ, CIGAR, RNEXT, PNEXT, TLEN, SEQ, QUAL) followed by a variable number of optional fields in the format TAG:TYPE:VALUE.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM @CO comment line reordering preserves semantics
quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) after canonical normalization (sorted @CO lines)

evidence.quote: @CO is a one-line free-text comment. Multiple @CO lines are allowed and their order is not semantically meaningful.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) after canonical normalization (sorted @HD subtags)

evidence.quote: The @HD line consists of key-value pairs in the format TAG:VALUE. The order of these pairs is not specified.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) after canonical normalization (sorted @SQ subtags)

evidence.quote: Each @SQ line consists of key-value pairs in the format TAG:VALUE. The order of these pairs is not specified.

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) after canonical normalization (sorted @RG subtags)

evidence.quote: Each @RG line consists of key-value pairs in the format TAG:VALUE. The order of these pairs is not specified.

quarantine.mr_name: CIGAR-SEQ length mismatch must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT the transformed file (raise validation error or crash). Silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The sum of lengths of the M/I/S/=/X operations shall equal the length of SEQ.

quarantine.mr_name: Unmapped flag with mapped coordinates must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT the transformed file (raise validation error or crash). Silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: Bit 0x4: segment unmapped. If this bit is set, RNAME MUST be '*' and POS MUST be 0.

quarantine.mr_name: Illegal optional tag type character must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT the transformed file (raise validation error or crash). Silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The type character MUST be one of: A (character), i (integer), f (float), Z (string), H (hex array), B (numeric array).

quarantine.mr_name: Same-signed TLEN on paired reads must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT the transformed file (raise validation error or crash). Silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: TLEN: observed Template LENgth. If all segments are mapped, the absolute value of TLEN must equal the distance between the leftmost and rightmost mapped positions of the template. For a paired-end read, the two reads of a template MUST have opposite signs.
